correctness.rationale: PASS: Maximizers of unsigned ideal-tetrahedron volume are exactly conjugate cross-ratio equilateral shapes. The Marshall-Martin normalized cross-ratio density includes two log terms and Bloch-Wigner contribution; differentiating the Bloch-Wigner differential identity reproduces the Hessian -sqrt(3)I/2, the cubic v(3u^2+7v^2)/12 and quartic sqrt(3)(u^4+18u^2 v^2-15v^4)/48. Independently evaluated its density 0,1,2 jets and angular trigonometric moments in symbolic/high-precision calculations, confirming C1=(64v3-32sqrt(3))/9 and C2=32(104sqrt(3)v3-183)/243, negative. Real-analytic Morse straightening eliminates odd half-integer cap powers and yields O(epsilon^3) remainder. Smooth positive density gives two equally likely conjugate caps and uniform disk radius 2/3^(1/4) for cross-ratio displacement/sqrt(epsilon). No full CDF asserted.
residual_risks: Numerical quadrature used only for consistency; analytic cap expansion supplies error.
